# Sona 1.3

Swipe to queue from anywhere, rearrange a shuffled queue, and make Sona move and feel the way you like.

## 👆 Swipe actions

- In an album, artist or playlist, **swipe a track, album or artist** one way to **play it next**, the other way to **add it to the queue**.
- A light tick tells you when letting go will act, and another if you pull back and change your mind.

## 🎶 A queue you can shape

- **No more reorder mode**: drag any row by its handle, any time.
- Works **while shuffled** too, and the order you set is the order it plays.
- **Swipe a row** one way to play it next, the other way to remove it, with an **undo** that puts it back exactly where it was.

## 🎛️ Motion, refresh rate and haptics

- **Disable animations**, **Force high refresh rate** and **Haptics** now actually work.
- Animations start off on low-memory phones, and the refresh rate setting shows your display's fastest rate.
- **Round mode** now shapes the whole app. Turn it off for **square corners everywhere**, not just on covers.

## 📚 Playlists, simplified

- Playlists now shows **just the playlists you made**, with **Most played** pinned on top once you've played enough.
- One **New playlist** button: start **empty**, **from a folder** or **from a playlist file**, and the name is filled in for you.
- An empty Playlists screen offers to **create your first playlist**.
- The **Playlists card** shows the cover of your top playlist.

## ✨ Fresh defaults

For settings you haven't changed yet: tracks and playlist tracks show **newest added first**, playlists sort by **last changed**, covers are **square**, the seek bar is **circular**, and the fast scroller's grab area is **Narrow**. Rewind before skip back and Stop after current track now start **off**.

## 🐛 Fixes

- Sideways swipes on the cover and mini player **no longer drag the player sheet** by accident, and scrolling a list **no longer swipes a row**.
- Swiping past the first or last cover **and back** now turns to the next cover.
- Removing a track from a **shuffled queue** no longer flashes it in the wrong order.
- Importing a playlist file that matches nothing **no longer leaves an empty playlist**.
- Long pressing the **artist name** in the player now vibrates like the title does.
